summary: Certified the ResizeObserver/--nav-h CSS-variable fix for the sticky search bar gap bug on /stays and /home. The fixed search bar is now perfectly flush with the nav at every viewport (gap=0px at rest, 0.5px sub-pixel after scroll) AND correctly tracks the nav as it shrinks on mobile scroll (103px→81.5px) and sm scroll (123px→101.5px). The previous 21px white gap is GONE. All regression checks (WhenPicker width, WherePicker autocomplete, QuickChips mobile, Home pill 12px offset) pass.

critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is clean: useElementHeight hook properly seeds height to avoid 0-height first paint, ResizeObserver disconnect is wired in cleanup, and the --nav-h CSS variable is published from a single source (Navigation). The 'magic numbers' anti-pattern from prior iterations has been fully eliminated.

Minor: barRef on Stays.jsx targets a div wrapping StaysSearchBar — this is fine, but consider that if QuickChips loads holiday data async and renders new chips after first paint, the ResizeObserver inside useElementHeight will correctly re-fire and adjust paddingTop. No issue, just noted for future regression awareness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix certified. Initial gap = 0.0px and scrolled gap = 0.5px (sub-pixel) across all tested viewports (390/540/640/720/768/900/1280). Nav-shrink-on-mobile-scroll behavior confirmed (103→81.5 on <sm, 123→101.5 on sm-md) and the fixed search bar correctly follows via the --nav-h CSS variable + ResizeObserver. Home page pill sits exactly 12px below nav bottom per spec (calc(var(--nav-h) + 12px)). Content clearance from bar to first listing heading is 24px on every viewport — no hidden content. All regression checks (WhenPicker 570px wide, WherePicker autocomplete returning 6 Jerusalem options for 'jeru', 9 QuickChips visible on mobile <768px) pass.
rca of the issue: RCA: prior iteration hard-coded `top-[103px] sm:top-[128px] md:top-[68px]` on the fixed search bar, but Navigation.js dynamically shrinks the nav on scroll via the mobileScrolled state (icon strip collapse) — nav went 103→82 on mobile and 123→102 on sm-md, while the bar stayed pinned to 103/128. This left a 21px gap. Fix: Navigation now publishes its live offsetHeight to document.documentElement.style.--nav-h via ResizeObserver; Stays.jsx and Home.js consume the variable via `style={{ top: 'var(--nav-h)' }}` and `paddingTop: 'calc(var(--nav-h) + Npx)'`. Stays.jsx additionally uses a useElementHeight hook on the bar wrapper so the page paddingTop tracks barHeight dynamically. Mitigation verified: scrolled gap stays at 0.5px (sub-pixel rounding) instead of the previous 21px.
